notes.title: Elea is getting a new AppID!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Over the last year, Elea has changed quite a lot. We got through Early Access, released on Xbox and next week the PS4 version will launch. With the release of the PS4 version on [i][b]July 25th[/b][/i], all the improvements Kyodai has made for the console versions will be implemented back into the Steam version. However, this means that  current save games are no longer compatible with the new version of the game. To make sure noone loses their old save games, and everyone still gets to play the latest version, we've created a new AppID for Elea, which means there's a new store page and library listing for that version. After launch on the 25th, the store page for the old Elea will be hidden, and only the new version will be available for purchase. It will remaind available to play for everyone who owns it before then. 

[b]So to recap:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new library listing and store page for Elea will launch on July 25th. This means you'll then have Elea in your Steam library twice. Both will remain playable.
[*]For everyone currently playing Elea; don't worry, you can continue playing the old Elea with your current save game.
[*]For everyone who wants to try the latest version; you'll automatically find the new Elea in your library on [i][b]July 25th[/b][/i]. 
[/list]

We want to thank you all for your support. It's been a great experience and we hope you've enjoyed the evolution of Elea as well so far!

The new Store Page for Elea can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122150/


[b]So what's changed in this new version of Elea? Here's the Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New asynchronous save system with more checkpoints (almost double in number) is implemented. It’s faster, stutterfree and way more secure.
[*]A new dynamic lighting system is introduced in the game. It uses volumetric lights and effects, and makes the realistic PBR shaders in the game to shine in their complete beauty.
[*]The PC version is optimized to make use of the new generation of video cards, allowing users to play at very high FPS and benefit from better shadows, anti aliasing, anisotropic filtering, screen space reflections and post-processes profiles.
[*]New scenes are introduced in the game.
[*]New object highlight mechanic is introduced (this was heavily suggested by players).
[*]The memory management is improved and this leads to faster loading and better overall performance.
[*]A lot of new visual effects, assets and sounds are introduced.
[*]There is a new option, that allows players to skip conversations / subtitles (this option can be controlled via the settings screen).
[*]We’ve updated all interaction icons and the whole experience in the game worlds.
[*]The localization is updated.
[*]Overall there are more than 200 bug fixes and additions.
[/list]

See ya!

-Bas

It's Marten here with some fresh patch notes! v1.1 is live now and it's the first update since launch! Here's what we've done:
[list]

notes.title: Elea is out of Early Access! v1.0 now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is a great day, because after 4,5 months of Early Access, Elea's v1.0 is now available! 

First off, I really want to thank you all for participating in the Early Access and helping us improve, shape and make Elea to what it is now. Just to emphasize what you've helped us achieve, here's a list of the most important changes and updates we've done in 10 huge updates over the Early Access period:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
A huge amount of gameplay changes have been implemented based on the community input. Elea can now sprint in the entire 'Recovery' chapter (minus when there's a conversation with other characters) for faster paced gameplay. We've added an entirely new hint system, created more clear objectives, highlighted important assets/objects, implemented faster movement in the house segment, etc.

[b]New Content[/b]
We added tons of new content in the ten updates. We've implemented a new help screen, a new story overview intro screen, a new cinematic intro, a new after credits final, we've added more than 50 new assets, implemented full 5.1 surround with spatial audio support, new voiceovers for some of the characters, new music tracks, new save checkpoints (three more compared to the first EA version), and we've unlocked the framerate up to 120 frames per second (versus 60FPS in the earlier versions).

[b]Optimization[/b]
We've optimized the streaming system and reworked it specifically for the PC version (from v0.9 of the game). There's been texture optimizations, implemented streamable audio, optimized the interface of the game for 4K resolutions (from v0.95 version of the game), implemented localization fixes and updates and added better screen space reflections (SSR) on ultra settings for more powerful PCs, etc.

Version 1.0 is the content complete version of the game. This does not mean this is the final update for the game, though. We'll still be fixing bugs and optimizing the game, based on your feedback.

Last but not least, here's the patch notes for the v1.0 update:
[list]
[*]Optimization of the level loading system
[*]Optimization of the save & load system
[*]Update of some meshes and textures
[*]Audio improvements
[*]Localization fixes and updates
[*]Over 100 bug-fixes
[*]Unlockable image effects that change the game visuals after successful completion of the episode.
[*]A surprise new “In the next episodes” scene just after the credits.
[*]The final chase sequence is polished and new QTE animation is added
[/list]
I can't thank you all enough for all the feedback and support you've given us over the Early Access period. We're very proud of the final version of Elea, and we couldn't have done this without you.

Have fun playing Elea and we'll see you in the next episode!

-Marten

notes.title: Patch v0.8 is live now! Sound updates + Memory Optimization
notes.content:
Hey all!

Today there's another update, it's time for v0.8!
[list]
[*]Huge audio update - Elea now features full 5.1 surround support (you need a 5.1 surround system to experience this) and better mastering for the sound mix (stereo and 5.1)
[*]Audio is streamed instead of cached in the memory all the time. This optimizes memory
[*]Fixed a bug where saves made at the beginning of the Broken Mindscape level would dissapear
[*]Fixed the bug where the Oculus & Vive app would open when starting the game
[*]Now you can run/sprint in every Recovery chapter floors (there's an exception when there's a controlled situation like conversations/cutscenes) 
[*]You can run longer compared to v0.7. Your sprint will recharge once you move slower, so in practice, you can run almost all the time 
[*]Some visual changes/updates (for example, the final scene has a new visual facelift)
[*]Some scripting updates/changes
[*]Smaller input icons 
[*]Localization fixes and updates
[*]Over 20 small bug-fixes
[/list]
If you have anything to report or any questions, let me know in the comments below or start a new discussion in the Community Hub!

Thanks all!

-Marten

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug when Oculus app is opening when starting the game
[*]Unlocked FPS option now supports 120 fps
[*]New auto-save checkpoints are implemented in the Recovery chapter
[*]Additional and improved objective hints
[*]Completely new how to play help screen is available in the settings menu and at the start of the game
[*]Various performance updates in regards to the streaming system in the game
[*]New voice over for some characters
[*]Better screen space reflections (SSR) when effects in the settings menu are on ULTRA. The higher version of SSR can decrease your performances with up to 10FPS. Effects settings on HIGH in the new 0.7 build are comparable in quality to Ultra in the older builds. 
[*]New voice lines for Elea - some of them can potentially help with the game progression
[*]Fixed the bug in which Elea can stuck in the first room in the house chapter
[*]Faster animations for the interaction icons in the game 
[*]Improved and completely new scenes in the game
[*]Updated localization
[*]Fixed the bug when after you finish the Mars level, two Alice's at the same time appeared
[*]Opportunity for infinite running in Mars chapter
[*]Increased sprint duration before having to recover in the Recovery chapter
[*]New and updated sound fx

I'd love to hear what you think of the new stuff we added! If there's anything else you'd like to let us know, please do! Write a comment down below or start a new discussion in the Community Hub.

Bye!
